svg.title: Enzora: mutation-library design, evidence-informed Agent screening and candidate delivery
svg.desc: Method schematic, not an experimental result. A real 544-residue predicted input fold accompanies three-model mutation design. Phenom links enzyme sequence and substrate graph; EpHod and UniStab provide distinct predictions and uncertainty evidence. Enzora Assistant requests validated objective weights. Explicit Next Process gates separate the stages. Top-K proteins, traceable reports and optional synonymous host-specific DNA are delivered. Protein geometry is an orthographic projection of the supplied prediction. CO2 is shown as chemical identity only, not a binding pose.
svg.text: Build a budgeted, three-model mutation library
Screen with distinct predictions and evidence-aware balancing
Validated policy; distinct uncertainty sources are not calibrated probabilities.
Deliver interpretable candidates and host-ready coding sequences
Method schematic. Predicted input fold and learned-interaction icons are illustrative; computational candidates await wet-lab validation.
